Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 336)

Mute browser tabs

  • Mute or unmute a browser tab from its right-click menu, from Cmd+P (Mute tab), or with a click on its speaker icon.
  • A tab that plays sound shows a speaker in place of its icon. A muted tab shows a red crossed-out speaker. Workspaces show the same icons for their tabs.
  • A muted tab stays muted after you close and reopen it, and after a restart.

Google Meet

  • Meet gets its microphone and camera back when another page stops using them.
  • The floating Meet window has a slim header, so its buttons no longer cover the call.

Quick AI

  • /rename is in the command list, and the session name shows on the right above the input.
  • Typing ! only changes the colour. The input keeps its font and place.
  • One thin line separates the folder chip from the input. The session name is dimmer.
